items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: we had this skeleton arrangements, you know, behind Edith Wilson, the old singer Edith Wilson.

ctx.x: When you made those recordings like in 1923, 24, were you using arrangements with those bands? No, no arrangements.

Then you were at living on the one? Yeah, at living, that's right. And I've always felt more freely at living than when I'm reading the music. You see now this recording we made just a few days ago, we had this skeleton arrangements, you know, behind Edith Wilson, the old singer Edith Wilson. Well we had, she had a background, we just caused, you know? And then spots where certain guys take solos. Now I recorded two of my own tunes. I sang on this, which I'm not much of a singer, but I think it may pass on…
Huh? Do you have a lead sheet to those numbers?
